description: Opus S unit 7b: Flower Gift. Ninetales' Drought (switch-in priority 0) sets sun at the start; the WeatherChange turns Cherrim into Cherrim-Sunshine before its own onStart (-2). The turn: Cherrim Protects; Ninetales' Hyper Voice hits Snorlax, whose SpD Flower Gift raises 1.5x (onAllyModifySpD); Snorlax's Double-Edge on Ninetales with Attack 1.5x (onAllyModifyAtk); Blissey Hardens.
